label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
To: #team-selection
Replying to: s01
Cc: none
Subject: none

Good evening Marek,

Thank you for posting the lineup. I do not agree with Liliana being the reserve, and I would like to ask you to look at it again before you send the names on Friday.

On 1 October you wrote here that selection would look at two things, the November FIDE list and form in club events, including the rapid qualifier. You also wrote that the coaches of the players would be consulted before the final lineup. I was not consulted, and the lineup as posted is based on the rating list only.

About the rating: Liliana's -81 comes from one tournament, the Katowice open in early October, as Joanna noted when the list came out. For health reasons she was not at full strength there, but she still played every game, and afterwards she missed about two weeks of training. That result does not show her real level, and it is the only reason she is now 23 points behind Igor.

About form: in the qualifier on 24 October she finished second with 5.5/7, beat Maja and Antoni and drew with Kacper. Igor was fourth with 4/7. She is back at her normal level and her last three lessons were very good.

I want to be clear that I have nothing against Igor. He is a good boy and a steady player, and Rafael is right about his autumn. For me this is only about applying the criteria that were announced.

My proposal is Liliana on board 2. If you prefer not to decide it that way, I am also fine with a short match between Liliana and Igor before Friday, and I will accept the result. I am happy to help arrange it.

Please let me know soon which option you choose, so that there is still time for the match if it is needed.

Regards,
Oksana
